summary: Tested Pet Friend (Lumi) app end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (root, lessons by age 7 & 15, get lesson by id, 404, pet phrase, gibberish, health). Frontend: Full onboarding flow (welcome -> name -> age -> hobbies -> finish) navigates to home, then home interactions (chat input, vocab counter, quick chips, lessons nav, profile nav, lesson items rendering) all functional. All required testIDs present and working.

issues: Several console deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props should be migrated to boxShadow; 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated -> use style.pointerEvents. Cosmetic only, do not break the app.

react_native_issues.issue: Web console: 'useNativeDriver is not supported' on web. Expected on web, no impact on mobile native. No action needed unless app must look identical on web preview.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents where used.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend cleanly separates content (LESSONS_DB / PET_PHRASES) and exposes only read-only endpoints — matches unidirectional download requirement.
Frontend correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via process.env (no hardcoding observed).
All interactive elements expose testID. Mobile-first layout, touch targets >=44px (mic 60px, side btn 52px, hobby pills ~40px height).
expo-speech & expo-notifications are guarded so web preview does not crash (verified).
seed_data_creation: None (content is statically embedded in backend; AsyncStorage cleared during test via localStorage.clear()).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py and target EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. To re-test frontend, clear localStorage to force onboarding. Profile screen is reached via /profile route or btn-profile from home. Pet replies are intentionally gibberish-heavy until fluency rises (vocab grows with user input).
